jobs.title: Fullstack Engineer
jobs.description:
Location:
Oslo, Bergen, anywhere in Norway

Salary:
850-980k NOK/year

Fullstack Engineer

Help us create the software platform that will change Norwegian healthcare forever.

The mission

We're building the healthcare platform all Norwegians deserve — an integrated set of services that lets institutions, clinicians, social workers, and citizens collaborate as a single team. We want every person in Norway to enjoy the longest, happiest life possible. That means improving the everyday lives of healthcare workers, giving patients more control, and maybe saving a few lives along the way.

It doesn't get more meaningful than that.

The Teams

Team Patient

Crafts Mitt Aidn — our portal and mobile application serving as the daily digital doorway connecting citizens, families, and municipal care providers.

The problems the team is working on right now:

Rolling out a consumer-facing native app with biometric login and instant push notifications, transforming standard web access into an essential daily companion.
Crafting fine-grained consent models that balance parental rights for minors with automated confidentiality protections for teenagers.
Replacing paper-heavy processes by converting legacy paper authorizations into streamlined mobile sign-offs.

Team Case Handling

Empowering municipal caseworkers with a unified toolkit to navigate the entire lifecycle of care management — from initial intake and smart dispatch, through tailored service decisions and ongoing follow-up, all the way to secure archiving.

The problems the team is working on right now:

Giving case handlers a single, role-aware view — patient overview, tasks, care plans, notifications and search across all departments.
Building a way to route incoming applications and messages to the right case handler based on workload, competence and location
Piloting AI-assisted case handling to improve decision quality and save caseworkers time — laying the groundwork for broader adoption in 2027.

Team Collaboration

Focuses on planning and optimisation — an area defined by complex algorithms, dense data, and a genuine obsession with giving health workers the best possible conditions to do their jobs.

The problems we're working on right now:

How do we manage home services staff, competencies, and schedules without a robust workforce system integration?
How do we organise and execute treatment plans collaboratively across different disciplines of care?
How do we build route plans that account for variable-length visits, driver skills, and multi-driver coordination — not just geography?
Can our solver run fast enough to keep planners in the loop, rather than disappearing for 10 minutes in the background?
Can lessons from home services routing apply to institutional ward planning?

The role

You'll work in a small, cross-functional team alongside product managers and designers, with the freedom to make real decisions. Your core responsibilities:

Design and implement end-to-end features that solve real clinical planning problems
Keep backend services and frontend applications well-aligned
Refactor confidently as you learn from users and peers
Help define best practices that actually work for your team
Own operational support for the services you build

Building great software requires experienced technologists with the right mindset. It is a continuous, iterative process of listening, learning, and steady improvement. We need people who can do more than just write code.

What We're Looking For

We hire for mindset first. The right attitude — curiosity, ownership, a collaborative spirit — matters more to us than ticking every box on the stack.

That said, you'll thrive here if you have:

Experience building greenfield SaaS products as a fullstack engineer
The ability to weigh trade-offs and make sound architectural decisions
Strong communication — you can articulate ideas and the reasoning behind them
Experience in product-led startups with autonomous, cross-functional teams
A collaborative mindset with a strong sense of ownership

On the tech stack:
Our core is PostgreSQL, C# .NET, and React / Next.js + TypeScript. You don't need to know all of it — but you should be comfortable working across the stack and confident picking up what you don't already know. Experience in adjacent technologies is genuinely fine; we care more about how you think than what you've used.

A passion for healthcare is a bonus. Understanding the weight of the problem helps.

If that sounds like you, Aidn might be just what you’re looking for.

To achieve our ambitions, product teams must have freedom to take decisions and demonstrate initiative as the company continues to grow. By joining in this early stage, you can have a huge impact on how our products are designed and implemented.

What Success Looks Like

We believe clarity helps everyone thrive. Here’s what success could look like in this role:

In 3 months:

You’ve gotten to know our platform, our teams, and our priorities—and built trust with key stakeholders.
You’ve shipped small but impactful functionality to production and can see its impact and usage through our metrics.
You’re participating in team discussions, asking for help and questions, and helping us see things we might miss.

In 6 months:

You’re a go-to person for questions related to what you have built and a dependable force in our delivery process.
You’ve taken ownership of a piece of your domain—maybe a new feature, a shared service, or even a new subdomain.
You’ve helped improve how we work—whether through automation, documentation, or nudging us toward better defaults.

In 12 months:

You’re assisting initiatives that improve user experience, resilience, scale, and developer experience across the company.
You’ve helped embed best practices across product teams, improved developer experience, and reduced friction on behalf of our users.
You’ve become a voice in product and technology strategy—helping shape not just how we work, but what we work on.

What You Get

Competitive salary + employee shares
6 weeks vacation
Flexible hours and location — work from home, or occasionally abroad is totally fine and flexible, however some teams are co-located in Oslo and Bergen, and would love to see you at the office regularly
A direct line to professional managers invested in your personal growth
Early-stage influence on how our products are designed and built

Aidn is part of the
Kernel cooperation
, where we build technology for the next generation of welfare societies.
With financial backing in order, we are privileged to be a fully autonomous startup busy building our company from the ground up the way we see fit.

Aidn recognizes and celebrates diversity in all its forms, visible and non-visible in all areas of the work environment. We work to promote an anti-discriminatory environment where everyone feels safe and welcome.

Read our full Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging policy in our handbook here.

Are you curious? We welcome you to check out our employee handbook to get to know us, some of our benefits, and what drives us.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Developer
jobs.description:
Making life accessible

iLOQ is an international company headquartered in Finland that offers intelligent locking systems and total access management solutions. We provide secure and efficient access to buildings and facilities. Our mission is to make everyday life easier with a diverse range of safe and sustainable products for individual buildings, large real estate complexes and critical infrastructure sites.

We reinvented the lock. iLOQ's self-powered digital locking and mobile access solutions work without batteries or mechanical keys, something nobody thought was possible until we did it. But the lock is only half of the story.

Behind every iLOQ lock is iLOQ 5 Series+. iLOQ 5 Series + is our modern, cloud-based, AI-enabled software platform which powers access management for buildings and large real estate complexes across the world. Locks, keys, apps and cloud services are all working as one system: this is where hardware innovation meets serious software engineering. Scalable backend services, security-critical design and a platform that keeps evolving with new AI-driven capabilities.

We are now looking for a Senior Backend Developer
to join our Software organization in Oulu. You will design, develop and maintain the secure, reliable and scalable backend services at the core of iLOQ 5 Series+. This is a role for an experienced software professional who enjoys solving complex problems, takes ownership beyond writing code and wants to influence both technical solutions and the way software is developed.

What you'll do

As a Senior Backend Developer, you will work as part of a cross-functional software team and contribute throughout the software lifecycle.

You will:
Design, develop, test and maintain reliable, scalable backend services and APIs for our cloud-based platform
Take end-to-end ownership of services from design and implementation to release, monitoring and continuous improvement
Translate functional and non-functional requirements into practical technical solutions
Explore and apply AI-assisted development tools in a secure and responsible way
Review code and develop automated tests, supporting high standards for security, quality and maintainability, and contributing to efficient CI/CD practices
Investigate and resolve complex technical issues
Contribute to the modernization and continuous development of our software architecture
Collaborating with Product Owners, Software Architects, Test Engineers and other stakeholders, share knowledge and support the development of colleagues.

What you'll bring

To succeed in this role, we expect you to have:
Relevant degree (Bachelor or Master)
Several years of professional experience in backend software development, including designing and implementing APIs and backend services
Strong skills in C# and .NET or comparable backend technologies
Experience with cloud technologies, preferably AWS, and a solid understanding of microservice architectures and distributed systems
Experience working with relational databases and data-driven applications
Familiarity with automated testing, CI/CD and modern software development practices
An understanding of software security, maintainability and operational reliability
The ability to analyze complex problems and turn them into clear, sustainable solutions
A proactive and collaborative working style with strong communication skills, including professional written and spoken English

We consider experience in the following areas an advantage:
AWS services and cloud-native application development
Event-driven architectures and asynchronous communication
Service monitoring, logging and observability
Secure software development or access management solutions
High-availability or business-critical systems
Working with software solutions that interact with physical products or devices

What you'll get

You will build products that end up in buildings all over the world and ease the everyday lives of our customers. You will have real responsibility and freedom to operate without big corporation bureaucracy. We ensure you’ll have room to grow professionally in a fast-growing international company.

We offer you a workplace within a collaborative and forward-thinking company culture, friendly and skilled colleagues, proper onboarding, and a solid benefits package: bonus program, full lunch benefit, extensive occupational health care with an annual dental check, life insurance, plus regular team and company events.

We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where diversity is valued and all employees are treated with respect. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply and join us in promoting an inclusive and diverse workplace.

Are you the person we are looking for?

We are expecting your application by October 14th at the latest. Please note that we might be reviewing candidates and conducting interviews during the application process and filling the position as soon as the right person has been found.

jobs.title: Software Development Consultant (early career)
jobs.description:
Are you looking to grow not only as a software developer, but also as a trusted advisor? At Columbia Road, we're looking for talented developers to help businesses grow while you grow your career. If you've already gained some hands-on experience in professional software development and are eager to grow into a skilled consultant in a low-hierarchy, supportive environment, we would love to hear from you. Let’s find your Road!

TLDR

Role: Software Developer (Associate Consultant or Consultant)
Focus: Help businesses grow by building and improving digital sales channels and systems for our clients.
Environment: Low-hierarchy, supportive, community-led, with an emphasis on transparency and trust.
Team: Varying teams built around each individual client’s need. Cross-competence collaboration.
Ideal Candidate: A couple years of professional web development (full-stack) experience, eager to learn and make an impact. The position is also suitable for someone finishing their studies. Fluent in English and Finnish.
Location: Helsinki or Tampere, no visa sponsorships offered.
Salary & benefits: Monthly gross salary 3000-4500€, depending on your experience and stage of potential studies. Extensive benefits package, including e.g. comprehensive healthcare insurance, allowance for sports/massage/commuting and compensation for doing social good & open source projects to name a few.

Who we are

Columbia Road is the go-to consulting partner for businesses that want to sell better. Excelling in both commercial operations and scalable technology, we build seamless and effective customer journeys for measurable impact. In each of our projects, we focus on generating more revenue and more customers for our clients, working in cross-competence teams made up of the brightest minds in digital commerce.

As a community-led company, we believe in giving a lot of responsibility and freedom to our employees. Instead of line managers and red tape, we offer the tools and resources to all Roadies to make the best possible decisions for their own job and for our community. We offer you a diverse and inclusive workplace, and your fellow Roadies will ensure that you’ll feel comfortable from day one.

The job & what you’d be working on

As a software developer, you are interested in what happens under the hood of modern digital sales channels. You’ll get to work together with other Columbia Road consultants in a cross-competence team, building and growing new digital businesses for our customers in various fields of business. This means you may collaborate daily with designers, digital marketers, strategy consultants, data & AI specialists as well as our clients' stakeholders and team. You will be supported in your learning by peers in both development and other domains, and you’ll have the ability to create real impact in our clients’ businesses.

Your motivation comes from the results and impact your solution creates, rather than the technical beauty of the code. For us, technology is a tool to create business impact for our clients, and we are agnostic in choosing whichever tools best solve the challenge. This can mean widely used programming languages and frameworks, but also different CRM, CMS and ecommerce solutions that we customise and integrate to our clients’ other systems. We have listed some examples further below.

If you're looking for a workplace where you get a lot of responsibility and where you get to learn new things fast from more experienced peers, you'll find it here. You will get to grow with us, nurture your own ambitions and learn new skills within digital sales.

This position is a great fit for you if

You are a student in the final year of your studies, or have graduated within the past couple of years.
You have already gained professional work experience related to software development. For example, you may have worked part time in a professional setting during your studies.
You have a good understanding of the basic principles of both backend and frontend software development.
You’re agnostic in your tech-approach and are open to using a wide array of languages, frameworks, CRM and CMS systems and ecommerce platforms, selecting the tools that best match our clients’ needs.
Some of the most common languages we come across in our work are JavaScript, Typescript, PHP, Java and C#. We hope you are comfortable with more than one of these.
Other technologies seen as an advantage include: Clojure, Scala, Python, Go as well as any experience working with CMS, CRM and ecommerce platforms.
You are self-driven, proactive and want to continuously learn new things.
You understand the basics of digitalisation and you approach problems in an analytical manner.
You would love to work with challenging client cases supported by a diverse community of digital sales professionals.
You are comfortable communicating matters related to your own work and you enjoy working with other people in an agile environment – it’s not a problem for you to present your own ideas to a small group of people from time to time, for example in a workshop.
You have a “get things done” attitude towards your work.
You live (or plan to move) within commuting distance of Helsinki or Tampere and are open to working on-site according to client needs.
You are fluent in English and Finnish.

Recruitment process

Our recruitment process typically involves 2-3 interviews where we learn about your skills and what motivates you. You'll discover more about Columbia Road and meet various Roadies along the way. After our discussions, we'll reach out to your chosen references.
This is a permanent, full-time position with a flexible start date from August 2026. We hope to hear from you soon!

Benefits

A monthly gross salary of 3000-4500 euros, depending on your experience and stage of potential studies. In addition, we offer extensive benefits:
A community-led organisation with a high level of autonomy
A diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace
Option to buy stocks of the company through the common employee share program
Recurring training and learning sessions to support your professional growth
Regular mentoring with a Roadie of your own choosing - or several!
Offices in downtown Helsinki (with gym and pool) and Tampere
A wide selection of quality tools to use for your work (laptop, phone etc.)
Extensive health care services, including dental and mental health
Insurance for travel and free-time
Lunch benefit
Phone subscription benefit
Weekly breakfasts and healthy daily refreshments
Flexible sports, culture, commuting and massage benefit
Recurring Roadie-ideated events and activities

Owning complex features and technical problems end-to-end

MSSQL
Elasticsearch

Practical experience with AI-assisted development tools and workflows

Our product teams bring developers, Product Managers, and Product Designers together.

Developers are expected to understand the problem being solved and contribute to finding the solution – not simply implement specifications handed to them.

This role sits at a genuine inflection point. We are moving from finding accessibility problems to explaining and fixing them, and we are rebuilding how we develop software around AI agents that write, test and review code under human direction. jobs.description:
I Clever arbejder vi for en verden, der kører på el. Lige nu har vi brug for dig, der vil være med til at bygge og udvikle Dynamics 365 CRM-løsninger, som er med til at gøre det nemmere for vores kunder at vælge el i hverdagen.

Din rolle

Rollen er en frontend-udvikler med forståelse for backend udvikling. En rolle, der har et ben i begge lejre, som vil være med til at bygge og sætte retningslinjer for udviklingskomponenter i Microsoft Dynamics CRM.

Vi drømmer om dig, der vil være med til at bygge centrale komponenter med mange aftagere. Vi arbejder med et system, der er bredt anvendt og hyppigt videreudvikles, så du vil indgå i dialoger med mange interne interessenter. Med andre ord er de rammer, vi sætter i CRM-platform teamet ikke kun vigtige for os, men også for andre udviklingsteams’ arbejde med platformen. Konkret vil du operere med frontend komponenter i Microsoft Dynamics CRM.

I dagligdagen anvender vi PCF, typescript og custom pages mv. for at understøtte forretningens processer i CRM.

Hos os har vi ikke klassiske titler. Vi har profiler. Når vi kalder rollen ”frontend-udvikler”, er det, så du og resten af verden ved, hvem vi leder efter. Men når du starter hos os, bliver din profil ”Ansvarlig for udvikling i Dynamics 365 CRM” – for det er netop det, du er.

Din hverdag

Din hverdag vil blandt andet være fyldt med:

Udvikling af React, Typescript-baserede komponenter og custom pages i CRM.
Dialoger om optimal anvendelse af teknologi og principper inden for udvikling
Planlægning af projekter
Monitorering og drift af vores systemer
Samarbejde med fagligt stærke og hjælpsomme kollegaer, der alle har samme mål for øje

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du har god erfaring med React og Typescript, og at du har arbejdet med Dynamics CRM før. Du har prøvet at bygge centrale systemer med mange aftagere, hvor du har mærket, hvad der skal til for, at de fremstår robuste og vedligeholdelsesvenlige.

Erfaring med udvikling af frontend-komponenter i Dynamics CRM
Brænder for gode UI/UX-oplevelser i Dynamics CRM
Erfaring med React eller andet frontend framework
Erfaring med integrationer og kommunikation mellem systemer
Erfaring med C# og .Net og forståelse for backend-udvikling er et plus

Hvem bliver dine legekammerater?

Du vil blive en del af CRM-platform teamet , hvor vi arbejder tæt sammen, og derfor primært befinder os på vores kontor.

Vi er seks fuldtidsansatte og en studentermedhjælper. Det vil sige en platforms- og strategiansvarlig, to Dynamics platformsspecialister, en koordinator, en release manager samt vores cloudarkitekt- og backendudvikler. Dine tætteste kollegaer vil primært være i dit eget team, men vi arbejder også tæt sammen med et andet CRM-team.

Derudover er der gode muligheder for at skabe netværk og samarbejde med andre frontend-udviklere i Clever.

Medledelseskompetencer (vi er nemlig organiseret anderledes)  

Du tager naturligt ansvar for både dig selv og dine kollegaer, med omsorg og nærvær  
Du er en holdspiller, der ser arbejde som et samarbejde, ikke en konkurrence  
Du holder dit ego i skak og ved, at succes handler om at løfte i flok mod fælles mål 

Har du sat mentale flueben hele vejen igennem?

Så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig. Finder vi det rette match, kan vi finde på at lukke opslaget før fristen. Så hvis du tænker, at det her job er det rigtige for dig, så send din ansøgning allerede i dag, så du er sikker på at komme i betragtning. Vi håber, at vi gennem din ansøgning kan lære dig at kende og se, hvad du kan bidrage med. Det er fint, hvis du bruger AI-værktøjer til inspiration – men husk at personliggøre din ansøgning, da vi leder efter hele mennesker. Vi modtager kun ansøgninger igennem vores hjemmeside.

Du kan læse mere om, hvordan det er at arbejde hos os på: www.clever.dk/velkommen eller vores Instagramkonto @liveticlever. Er du nysgerrig på vores rekrutteringsproces kan du læse mere om den her: Rekrutteringsprocessen i Clever | Clever .

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

As a Software Engineer at Applied Materials, you’ll dive deep into ground-breaking technologies—like machine learning and AI—to craft novel software solutions that solve our customers’ high-value problems. Our Software Engineers are responsible for designing, prototyping, developing, and debugging software solutions for semiconductor equipment components and devices to ensure quality and functionality. You'll develop software documentation and test procedures, troubleshoot software problems, and communicate with internal customers to understand project requirements. As part of our team, you'll contribute your expertise in intricate systems, deciphering code, and anticipating software behaviors to ensure Applied remains the leader in the semiconductor and display sectors.

Role Summary

We are developing a manufacturing data and applications platform to support digitalization and automation across the organization. The role begins with building the foundational data layer—designing databases, pipelines, and system integrations—and progressively expands into developing business logic, backend services, and user‑facing applications on a modern manufacturing app platform. This position is well‑suited to an engineer who has demonstrable experience delivering production web applications to internal users, is comfortable working close to operations, and is eager to grow into a full‑stack role spanning data engineering, backend/API development, and front‑end application development.

Front-End / Application Development
Build user-facing applications on a modern manufacturing app platform software.
Integrate applications with backend services, connectors, and data sources.
Develop custom interface logic or extensions as needed.

Automated retries

At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

What do you know about protecting sensitive data? What about fine-grained access control (FGAC) on Big Data? Or attribute-based access control (ABAC) and context based authorization? What about catching bad actors that are abusing Amazon services? Or attacks that could potentially lead to a widespread data breach? Do you know how to generate activity-based intelligence (ABI) through anomaly detection?

In Security Products we build Access Policy Management systems to enable all Amazon teams to apply FGAC to their sensitive data. We build products that apply context based authorization to solve the problem of over-permissioning. We apply Machine Learning Techniques in our Monitored Access (MA) abuse detection program to preemptively detect and mitigate internal and external malicious actors. We do this to protect Amazon customer, seller, vendor and employee information across from constantly changing abuse actor behaviors and patterns.

In our newly created organization we have a rare opportunity to engage with multiple Amazon organizations and groups of experienced tech leaders to build products with impact at an impressive scale (hundreds of thousands of services).

We are looking for enthusiastic Software Development Engineers with strong analytical and problem solving skills, who will participate in full development cycle for mission critical systems. You will work with leading-edge technologies and tools, on innovative and sophisticated features, collaborate with your team and its leadership to drive key engineering and business decisions that will enhance the Amazon’s security posture. using Terraform
.

and GitHub

Monitor and improve the availability, performance, scalability and cost efficiency
of our cloud environments.

Maintain and improve observability using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics and Application Insights
.

Investigate infrastructure and deployment issues and work with Software Engineers to identify their root causes.

Work with Security Engineering to implement best practices around identity, access, network security and data protection
.

Participate in incident response and contribute to improvements following production incidents.

Maintain technical documentation and share knowledge across the team.

Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize and automate our infrastructure and operational processes.

What We're Looking For

Initial professional experience in a Cloud, DevOps, Infrastructure or similar technical role
.

or another major cloud platform, with a strong interest in developing deeper Azure expertise.

Experience with or a good understanding of Infrastructure as Code
. Experience with Terraform
is a strong advantage.

, Git and modern software delivery practices.

Scripting and automation skills; PowerShell

Interest in automation and improving existing solutions rather than relying on repetitive manual operations.

Ability to collaborate effectively with Cloud, Software Engineering, Security and other technical teams.

Fluent English

Experience with Terraform, Azure DevOps, GitHub, Azure App Services, Container Apps, Azure Functions or Azure SQL
is valuable, but we don't expect a Junior/Medior candidate to already have deep expertise across our entire stack.

The opportunity to work hands-on with a modern and evolving Azure SaaS environment

A team combining different experience levels, giving you room to learn while progressively taking greater technical ownership.

Professional development and certification support.

The opportunity to influence how we automate and operate our cloud platform as it continues to evolve.

A collaborative environment with close interaction between Cloud, Software Engineering and Security
teams.

jobs.title: Senior ProServe Cloud Architect, Healthcare and Life Sciences (HCLS), AWSI Sales
jobs.description:
Description

The Amazon Web Services Healthcare and Life Sciences (HCLS) Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking an experienced Clinical ProServe Cloud Architect (PCA) to join our team in Europe. In this role, you'll work directly with pharmaceutical and life sciences customers, including senior technology and business leaders, to understand their business objectives and translate them into innovative cloud and AI solutions that drive meaningful impact in pharmaceutical innovation.

As a PCA, you'll be responsible for creating and leading solution designs to address customer business outcomes (CBO) in the pharmaceutical domain. Operating as the conduit between ProServe Account Executives and our Shared Delivery Teams (SDT), you'll ensure proposed solutions are realistic, achievable, and optimized to maximize CBOs. You'll lead cloud modernization and AI transformation initiatives, designing scalable AWS solutions that address complex clinical development challenges including clinical trial management, clinical data operations, regulatory submissions, and study lifecycle optimization from protocol design through database lock. Your experience in designing technical solutions within the pharmaceutical sector will equip you to architect complex, scalable, and secure solutions tailored to meet specific customer needs, translating technical concepts into business value. Your success will be linked to impacting SOW signings and successful solution implementations that achieve CBOs while exceeding customer satisfaction (CSAT) expectations.

As a trusted technical advisor, you'll provide guidance on industry trends, emerging technologies, and agentic AI applications specific to pharma. You'll collaborate with expert teams including our Gen AI Innovation Center, Industry Sales, and Product teams to bring leading-edge innovation to customers. As a technical SME, you'll share knowledge within the organization through mentoring, training, and creating reusable tools such as demos, accelerators, and white papers.

Key job responsibilities

Design scalable, secure AWS solutions that deliver measurable customer business outcomes across HCLS development lifecycle.

Provide technical guidance during sales and implementation phases, focusing on pharmaceutical domain challenges including clinical data management, regulatory submissions (eCTD), study conduct optimization, and GxP compliance.

Partner with customers on industry trends and emerging technologies, particularly agentic AI applications in clinical trial automation, clinical data standardization (CDISC SDTM/ADaM), electronic data capture (EDC), and clinical trial management systems (CTMS).

Collaborate with Account Executives and Delivery Teams to ensure successful solution implementation.

Work with AWS experts and external partners to accelerate innovation.

Share knowledge through coaching, demos, accelerators, and technical documentation.

Basic Qualifications

5+ years of cloud architecture, designing and implementing cloud solutions.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, related field, or equivalent experience.
4+ years of deep technical experience in designing, solutioning, and building data platforms, AI/ML and /or GenAI solutions to achieve customer business outcomes
Experience managing and delivering large-scale enterprise IT projects, including hands-on experience, across Data, AI/ML, Application modernizations, or GenAI
Experience in presenting technical solutions to customer stakeholders and executive, including ability to translate complex technical architectures into business value propositions and strategic roadmaps that align cloud modernization initiatives with clinical development transformation objectives.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience architecting enterprise-scale clinical/commercial data platforms with proficiency in multi-agent orchestration frameworks, clinical data integration patterns (API-based, batch ETL, real-time streaming), and cloud-native data lake/lakehouse architectures, demonstrating ability to articulate how agentic AI transforms clinical operations through intelligent automation of study planning, site activation, patient recruitment optimization, clinical monitoring, and regulatory submission workflows.
Achieved AWS Professional level certifications (AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Professional, and AWS Certified Generative AI Developer – Professional or AWS Certified Machine Learning – Specialty) preferred.
Deep understanding of AWS services across compute, storage, networking, security, databases, machine learning, and serverless technologies.
Knowledge of security and compliance standards (e.g., HIPAA, GDPR).
Expertise in performance optimization and cost management for cloud environments.
Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences as part of pre-sales motion.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Pivotal is a leading full-service Contract Research Organization (CRO) in Europe, delivering clinical research excellence across global pharmaceutical and biotech sponsors. We are looking for an experienced Senior Software Engineer to join our Technology Services team and help build, evolve, and scale the platforms that power clinical trials — from electronic Trial Master Files to patient data capture systems.
This is not a typical corporate dev job. You will work on a GxP-validated clinical platform (Danah) serving real clinical studies, using modern AI-augmented development workflows. Our current stack is React + Vite on the frontend and .NET Core on the backend, but what matters most is your engineering fundamentals and your ability to learn fast with AI. We use Claude Code, Cursor, and multi-model AI tooling as part of our daily engineering practice — not as experiments, but as core productivity multipliers. If you are passionate about building meaningful software, working at the intersection of technology and medical science, and leveraging AI to move faster, this role is for you.
WHY PIVOTAL

Impact that matters.
Your code directly supports clinical trials that bring new treatments to patients worldwide.
AI-first engineering culture.
We build with Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, and custom AI skills — AI isn't a buzzword here, it's how we ship.
Growth by design.
We invest in our people: permanent mentoring, training budget, conference attendance, and international project exposure.
Diversity of thought.
A diverse, multicultural team across Europe where different backgrounds and perspectives are valued.

jobs.title: Global OT Application Engineer
jobs.description:
The Global OT Application Engineer implements, integrates, tests, deploys and supports industrial applications across manufacturing sites. The role configures and implements global use cases and applications.

The Application Engineer is the technical bridge between plants, application owners, developers, infrastructure and cybersecurity teams, software vendors and system integrators. The role covers both purchased or configured applications and internally built solutions; it is neither limited to software development nor to coordination.

Assigned scope:

Global OT applications across manufacturing sites, including MES/MOM, SCADA, IIoT and CMMS domains.
Purchased, configured and internally developed applications and their interfaces to plant and business systems.

Primary emphasis:

Applications are deployed safely, consistently and with clear acceptance evidence.
Plant systems exchange accurate and reliable data through governed interfaces.
Sites receive effective onboarding, technical support and operational handover.
Incidents and recurring technical problems are resolved at the appropriate support level.
Global templates and standards are applied without losing control of necessary local adaptations.

Main tasks / Standard of performance

Implementation and Integration:

Configure and implement applications, templates and technical components in accordance with the approved solution design.
Gather requirements to integrate applications with PLC, SCADA, DCS, MES/MOM, IIoT, historians and business systems such as ERP, LIMS or QMS.
Configure and troubleshoot industrial data exchange using technologies such as OPC UA, MQTT, REST APIs and SQL.
Ensure that global libraries, naming conventions, templates, interfaces and deployment standards are followed.
Document any approved local deviation from the global template, including its justification and approval, in the application documentation.
Review technical and functional deliveries from developers, vendors and system integrators and challenge gaps in quality, maintainability or operability.

Testing and Validation:

Translate approved requirements and designs into a complete and traceable technical test scope.
Prepare and execute functional, integration and regression tests and support FAT, SAT and user acceptance testing.
Diagnose bugs, coordinate correction and test cycles, and maintain clear test evidence and release documentation.
Verify connectivity, data integrity, performance, resilience, security controls and operational readiness.
Confirm that acceptance criteria are met before recommending release or production deployment.

Deployment and Site Onboarding:

Lead the technical work required to take an application from a controlled release into stable plant operation.
Assess site readiness, infrastructure, signals, interfaces, data availability and local dependencies.
Coordinate technical activities with plant stakeholders, local OT teams, vendors and system integrators.
Execute or supervise installation, configuration, commissioning and cut-over activities.
Provide hypercare, technical training, documentation and a clear handover to support and site teams.

Operations and Support:

Provide ITIL-based L2/L3 application support: advanced troubleshooting, functional bug-fixing and technical incident escalation across sites (ITIL support levels, not Purdue Model network layers).
Perform problem management: conduct root-cause analysis (RCA) and implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) for recurring application errors.
Manage technical change requests: oversee software modifications from assessment through testing, release and production deployment.
Monitor application health: track application performance, data interfaces (APIs) and support trends to recommend continuous improvements.
Maintain knowledge databases: manage technical documentation, application runbooks, release notes and Known-Error Databases (KEDB).

Plant and Technical Team Interface:

Act as the practical interface between plant operations and the teams that design, build and supply the applications.
Translate plant constraints and operational issues into actionable technical requirements and bugs.
Explain technical options, dependencies, risks and decisions to plant and business stakeholders.
Coordinate effectively with the Application Owner on priorities, scope, standards and acceptance.
Work with developers on build activities and with delivery leads or Scrum Masters on planning and execution.
Challenge vendors and system integrators on technical quality, delivery evidence and issue resolution, escalating commercial or roadmap matters to the Application Owner.

Skills And Competencies

Functional & Technical Competencies:

Strong knowledge of at least one relevant application domain: MES/MOM, SCADA, IIoT or CMMS, and of interfaces to PLC, SCADA and DCS systems.
Practical integration knowledge using OPC UA, MQTT, REST APIs and SQL.
Ability to read, adapt or create components using Python, C#, Java or JavaScript when needed.
Working knowledge of versioning, release, incident, problem and change-management practices.
Working knowledge of ISA-95 principles, OT cybersecurity and regulated validation requirements where applicable.

Behavioral Competencies:

Plant-oriented, pragmatic and structured, with strong ownership of technical issues.
Constructive challenge of delivery evidence from developers, vendors and system integrators.
Clear cross-functional communication across plant, specialist and external audiences.

Experience

Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelor's or master's degree in automation, electrical, software or industrial engineering, or comparable practical experience.
Experience with industrial applications, automation, MES/MOM, SCADA, IIoT or comparable manufacturing systems; senior appointments normally require demonstrated responsibility across multiple sites or complex industrial programs.
Professional English; additional languages relevant to the assigned region are an advantage.

Working Conditions and Location:

Primary European hiring locations Barcelona and southern or western Germany, plus a senior regional position in the north-eastern United States.
Home-based or hybrid working with regular domestic and international travel to manufacturing sites.

Responsibility / Power of authority

The Application Engineer:

Together with the Project Managers, defines implementation and configuration approaches within approved standards.
Stops or rejects a technical deployment when readiness or acceptance criteria are not met.
Recommends fixes, improvements and standard changes based on operational evidence.
Escalates architecture, security, scope and vendor-performance risks.
The role does not own application strategy, roadmap, backlog or commercial vendor decisions, does not act only as a software developer without integration, testing, support and site responsibilities, does not replace the plant's operational ownership or bypass agreed OT governance, and does not approve material deviations from global standards without the relevant owner or authority.

Team work / Team membership

Communicates to:

Application Owner: priorities, scope, standards, acceptance and escalation of commercial or roadmap matters.
Plant operations and local OT teams: site readiness, deployment activities, onboarding, training, support and operational handover.
Developers, delivery leads and Scrum Masters: build activities, defect resolution, planning and release execution.
Infrastructure and cybersecurity teams: interfaces, security controls, architecture dependencies and technical risk.
Software vendors and system integrators: technical quality, delivery evidence, testing and issue resolution.
Business and functional stakeholders (production, quality, maintenance, supply chain): technical options, dependencies, risks and decisions affecting plant operations.
Project managers: rollout planning and execution; sequencing, dependencies and escalation of deviations.

jobs.title: AI Automation & Integration Specialist
jobs.description:
Specialist Computer Centres, S.L.
, an English multinational company with a strong presence across Europe, dedicated to the development of projects, deployments, and implementation of IT services, is seeking an AI Automation & Integration Specialist

Main Mission
The AI Automation & Integration Specialist designs, develops, tests, deploys, secures and operates production-grade automations and integrations that connect business processes, enterprise applications, cloud services, data platforms and AI capabilities. The role is a hands-on senior engineering position within SCC Spain’s AI delivery capability, translating solution architectures and business requirements into resilient APIs, event-driven services, automated workflows and reusable integration components across Microsoft Azure and AWS. A core objective is to convert manual, fragmented or repetitive activities into secure, observable and reusable automated processes that deliver measurable operational outcomes. The role ensures that AI-enabled applications and automations are not isolated proofs of concept, but supportable production services that integrate reliably with customer processes and systems.
Key Responsibilities

Automation Development & Intelligent Process Orchestration
Maintain automation assets throughout their lifecycle, including versioning, testing, deployment, monitoring, incident resolution and continuous optimisation.
Refactor proofs of concept and low-code workflows into governed, observable and supportable production services when scale, criticality or complexity requires it.
Measure automation outcomes including transaction completion, processing time, failure rate, manual effort avoided, rework and operational cost.
Define exception paths, audit trails, manual recovery procedures and operational controls for business-critical automations.
Combine deterministic workflow logic with AI capabilities such as classification, extraction, summarisation, routing, decision support and agent tool execution.
Automate interactions with Microsoft 365 and enterprise platforms using Microsoft Graph, APIs, webhooks, events, queues and secure workload identities.
Build reusable connectors, custom connectors, workflow templates, automation libraries and common services that reduce delivery time across customer projects.
Implement scheduled, event-triggered, short-running, long-running and human-in-the-loop workflows, including state management, approvals, timeouts, escalation, compensation and recovery logic.
Design, develop, test, deploy and operate end-to-end automations using Azure Functions, AWS Lambda, Logic Apps, Durable Functions, Step Functions, Power Automate and code-based orchestration where appropriate.
Analyse business and operational processes to identify automation opportunities, define automation boundaries and translate requirements into maintainable technical workflows.

Cloud-native Integration & Automation Engineering
Design and implement API-first, event-driven and asynchronous integration solutions using Azure Functions or AWS Lambda, Event Grid or EventBridge, Service Bus or SQS/SNS, and workflow orchestration services such as Logic Apps, Durable Functions or Step Functions.
Build reusable automation components, connectors and integration services using C#, Python, TypeScript or PowerShell, applying appropriate software engineering standards.
Integrate enterprise systems, SaaS platforms, data services and AI endpoints through REST, GraphQL, webhooks, messaging and event streaming patterns.
Modernise legacy point-to-point integrations into loosely coupled, scalable and maintainable cloud-native patterns.
Assess and implement synchronous versus asynchronous patterns, delivery semantics, ordering, idempotency, deduplication, dead-letter handling and eventual consistency.

API Management & Enterprise Integration
Design, publish and govern APIs using Azure API Management and AWS API Gateway, including policies, authentication, authorisation, throttling, quotas, versioning, transformations, caching, lifecycle management and developer onboarding.
Create and maintain API contracts and documentation using OpenAPI specifications, consistent error models and backward-compatible versioning practices.
Integrate with Microsoft 365 services through Microsoft Graph, including appropriate permissions, consent models, webhook subscriptions, change notifications and throttling-aware implementations.
Collaborate with architects to define reusable integration reference architectures, standards and guardrails for customer delivery teams.

Identity, Security & Secrets Management
Implement workload identity and zero-trust patterns using Managed Identities, AWS IAM roles, OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect, avoiding embedded credentials wherever possible.
Protect credentials, certificates, keys and connection details using Azure Key Vault or AWS Secrets Manager, including secure rotation and access-control practices.
Apply least privilege, managed service-to-service authentication, network controls, encryption and secure API exposure throughout the integration lifecycle.
Contribute to threat modelling, security reviews and remediation of integration components in collaboration with Cyber Security and Cloud teams.

AI-enabled Workflow Integration
Integrate Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock, Microsoft Copilot Studio, AI agents and other model endpoints into enterprise workflows and applications.
Engineer the deterministic components around AI systems, including input validation, context retrieval, tool and function calling, business-rule enforcement, human approval, output handling and fallback paths.
Implement resilient orchestration for long-running or multi-step AI processes, with appropriate state management, timeout handling, compensation and human-in-the-loop controls.
Ensure sensitive data, prompts, model outputs and integration telemetry are handled in accordance with security, privacy and responsible AI requirements.

Observability, Reliability & Operational Excellence
Instrument integrations end to end using Application Insights, Azure Monitor, AWS CloudWatch and OpenTelemetry.
Implement distributed tracing, transaction correlation, correlation IDs, structured logging, metrics and actionable alerts across APIs, functions, queues, events and AI dependencies.
Design robust error-handling and resilience mechanisms, including retries with backoff and jitter, timeouts, circuit breakers, bulkheads, poison-message handling, dead-letter queues and replay procedures.
Define service-level indicators and operational dashboards covering availability, latency, throughput, error rate, queue depth, dependency health, cost and business transaction completion.
Perform production troubleshooting and root-cause analysis across distributed systems, and produce runbooks that enable effective support and incident response.

Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD & Quality Engineering
Provision and configure integration services using Terraform and Bicep, with modular, reusable and environment-aware infrastructure definitions.
Build CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, incorporating code quality, security scanning, automated tests, deployment approvals and rollback strategies.
Implement unit, contract, integration, end-to-end, performance, resilience and failure-mode testing for APIs, workflows and event-driven components.
Use source control, peer review, branching and release-management practices appropriate to enterprise delivery.
Optimise solutions for scalability, reliability, maintainability, performance and cloud cost.

Agile Delivery, Documentation & Continuous Improvement
Work with Product Owners, Architects, Testers, Cloud Developers, AI Engineers and service teams to deliver product increments against agreed sprint goals.
Produce clear technical documentation covering APIs, events, message schemas, data flows, identity, deployment, observability, support and recovery procedures.
Create proofs of concept and technical spikes to validate patterns, while ensuring successful patterns can be hardened for production use.
Mentor colleagues, review technical work and contribute reusable accelerators, standards and lessons learned to the wider AI and application practice.

Required Experience
5+ years of professional experience in software engineering, systems integration, cloud application development or automation, including at least 2 years delivering cloud-native integrations in production.
Demonstrable experience developing end-to-end business process automations, rather than only configuring integration platforms or defining architectures.
Demonstrable hands-on delivery of APIs, serverless components, messaging solutions and event-driven architectures on Azure or AWS.
Experience operating distributed integrations in production, including troubleshooting, performance analysis, resilience engineering and support handover.
Experience working in Agile delivery teams and collaborating with architecture, security, test, data and operations functions.
Fluent Spanish and professional working proficiency in English.

Preferred Qualifications
Experience in an IT services, systems integrator, managed services or consulting environment.
Relevant certifications such as Azure Developer Associate, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Azure DevOps Engineer Expert, AWS Developer or Solutions Architect, and HashiCorp Terraform Associate.
Experience with containers, Kubernetes, Dapr, Kafka or enterprise integration platforms is advantageous.
Experience delivering solutions for regulated or security-sensitive customers is advantageous.
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience in computer science, software engineering or a related discipline.

Working Conditions & Package
Hybrid working model, with Madrid preferred and flexibility to work from SCC Spain offices as required.
Travel within Spain for customer delivery, workshops and collaboration with SCC teams.

• Troubleshoot application outages or degraded performance issues.

• Perform root cause analysis and implement corrective actions end-to-end with development teams.

• Maintain operational runbooks, knowledge base articles, and support documentation.

• Improve operational visibility through dashboards, alerts, reporting, and service health indicators.

• Drive continuous improvements in monitoring coverage and alert quality.

Qualifications

• 2–3 years of experience in application support, site reliability, or service operations environments.

• Proven ability to investigate service degradation, performance issues, and availability incidents.

Highly desirable experience:

At AdvanceWorks, we learn together, grow together, and have fun together. And we do all this while creating great software solutions for clients across many industries and geographies.

About the project

You will join a public digital healthcare programme for a client in one of the Nordic countries. The work focuses on digital solutions used in the public healthcare sector, including interfaces built for healthcare staff and clinical specialists in their daily clinical work.
Depending on the client's needs, you may work across several of the client's initiatives or on a specific project. In both cases, you will work with cross-disciplinary teams and stakeholders towards clearly defined objectives, as part of a wider effort to support digital transformation and the client's strategic goals in healthcare.
Accessibility, security, and data protection are central to the project. The solutions follow WCAG 2.2 A and AA, apply security-by-design principles to defend against the OWASP Top 10, and handle medical record information under strict data protection rules. The interfaces connect to documented REST APIs with OpenAPI definitions and run on cloud-native platforms built to scale horizontally.
On the frontend, the technology stack follows one of two routes: .NET 8+ with ASP.NET Razor and/or HTMX, or React 18+ with strict TypeScript. Code quality is managed through a defined development handbook, and the team uses artificial intelligence in software development in a responsible and structured way.

What will be your role

We are looking for a Frontend Developer to build accessible, secure, and reliable interfaces for healthcare professionals in a public digital healthcare setting.
You will work either with .NET 8+ and ASP.NET Razor and/or HTMX, or with React 18+ and strict TypeScript, depending on your background. Your work will turn clinical and business needs into interfaces that healthcare staff can rely on, with accessibility, security, and data protection built in from the start.
You will work closely with cross-disciplinary teams and stakeholders, connecting your interfaces to documented REST APIs and contributing to cloud-native solutions designed for horizontal scaling. You will also take ownership of defined work packages, deliverables, and decisions, and may act as a point of contact with stakeholders for the parts of the solution you lead.
The role is fully remote from Portugal, with occasional trips to the client once or twice a year. Experience with healthcare projects is especially valued, as it gives a strong understanding of the context these interfaces are built for.

Your responsibilities will include

Developing frontend interfaces for healthcare staff and clinical specialists.
Building and releasing solutions with .NET 8+ and ASP.NET Razor and/or HTMX, or with React 18+ and strict TypeScript.
Applying strict TypeScript settings, including strict mode, noImplicitAny, strictNullChecks, and exactOptionalPropertyTypes, when working on the React route.

Integrating with documented REST APIs using JSON and OpenAPI definitions.
Using automatic code generation based on OpenAPI definitions.
Contributing to cloud-native solutions designed for horizontal scaling.
Applying resilience patterns such as retry and circuit-breaking.
Applying security-by-design principles and defending against OWASP Top 10 and CWE vulnerabilities.
Making sure information security and data protection requirements are met, including the handling of medical record information.
Ensuring code quality with the tools defined in the project's development handbook.
artificial intelligence in software development in a responsible and structured way.

Postgraduate or specialist university-level education in computer science or software engineering

jobs.title: Senior Consultant | Microsoft Power Platform, Microsoft 365 & AI
jobs.description:
Queres integrar uma das maiores organizações na prestação de serviços profissionais do mercado? Então a Deloitte é para ti. Aqui, vais ter a possibilidade de potenciar a tua carreira e de reforçar as tuas competências no nosso universo tecnológico.

Estamos a reforçar a nossa equipa de soluções Microsoft e procuramos um Senior Consultant com gosto pelo desenvolvimento aplicacional, pela automação e pela Inteligência Artificial. Vais transformar necessidades de negócio em aplicações e agentes de IA, combinando Power Platform, Microsoft 365 (Office 365) e Azure. Procuramos alguém que goste de desenvolver, resolver problemas e acompanhar as soluções até à sua utilização real pelos clientes.

Juntas-te a nós? Estamos à tua espera.

O teu dia a dia e responsabilidades:

Criar e evoluir soluções integradas com Microsoft 365, nomeadamente SharePoint Online e Teams, através de Microsoft Graph, APIs e conectores personalizados.
Estender soluções low-code com código, recorrendo a C#/.NET, JavaScript ou TypeScript e a serviços Azure, quando os requisitos o justifiquem.
Desenvolver agentes em Copilot Studio e integrar capacidades de IA generativa, assegurando acesso autorizado à informação, avaliação das respostas e supervisão humana quando necessária. :
Assegurar qualidade ao longo do ciclo de desenvolvimento: revisão de código, testes, documentação, gestão de versões e deployment entre ambientes através de práticas de ALM e CI/CD.
Aplicar boas práticas de segurança, privacidade, desempenho e governação, incluindo permissões, políticas de dados e monitorização das soluções em produção.
Assumir autonomia na entrega de componentes, apoiar colegas menos experientes e contribuir para demonstrações, propostas técnicas e ativos reutilizáveis.

És tu quem procuramos?

Formação superior em Engenharia Informática, Sistemas de Informação ou área semelhante, ou experiência profissional equivalente.
Pelo menos 4 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento aplicacional, incluindo 2 anos de experiência prática com Power Platform e entrega de soluções em produção.
Experiência sólida com Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse e Power Fx, incluindo modelação de dados e configuração de segurança.
Experiência de programação em pelo menos uma das seguintes tecnologias: C#/.NET, JavaScript ou TypeScript; capacidade de desenvolver e consumir APIs REST.
Experiência na integração de aplicações com SharePoint Online e/ou Teams e conhecimento dos mecanismos de identidade e permissões do ecossistema Microsoft.
Prática de controlo de versões com Git, testes e gestão do ciclo de vida de aplicações; capacidade de diagnosticar e resolver problemas técnicos.
Autonomia, espírito de equipa e capacidade de comunicar com interlocutores técnicos e de negócio, em português e inglês.

Valorizamos também:

Experiência com Copilot Studio, extensibilidade do Microsoft 365 Copilot ou integração de modelos de IA através de serviços Azure.
Certificações Microsoft relevantes em Power Platform, Azure ou IA e experiência em contexto de consultoria.

Desenvolve uma carreira à tua medida:

Um contexto de trabalho diverso, com desenvolvimento e aprendizagem contínuos e um plano de carreira ajustado às tuas competências, necessidades e objetivos.
Participação em projetos nacionais e internacionais, com dimensão e impacto relevante nesta área de especialização.
Acesso a plataformas de aprendizagem, como LinkedIn Learning e Udemy, e oportunidades de formação e certificação nas mais recentes tecnologias.

Vive uma cultura de união:

Uma cultura de inovação e excelência, num ambiente de respeito, confiança, transparência e informalidade.
Uma rede de líderes e especialistas com quem aprender, partilhar conhecimento e desenvolver soluções.
Oportunidade de participar nas nossas comunidades de tecnologia, inovação e outros interesses, e em projetos de responsabilidade social.

Na Deloitte nunca trabalharás sozinho. jobs.title: C# .NET Developer | Business Delivery Solutions
Senior Fullstack Developer – .NET Core / Angular / React
jobs.description:
Company Description

At Bosch, we shape the future by inventing high-quality technologies and services that spark enthusiasm and enrich people’s lives. Our promise to our associates is rock-solid: We grow together, we enjoy our work, and we inspire each other. Welcome to Bosch.

Job Description

As a Senior Fullstack Developer
, you will shape and develop internal digital products supporting HR, Purchasing and Engineering processes at Bosch. You will combine hands-on development with technical ownership, turning complex business needs into scalable, secure and user-friendly applications.

You will have a strong influence on architecture, technology choices and development standards while exploring how AI-enhanced development and agentic AI solutions
can take automation to the next level.

For the right candidate, the position also offers a clear opportunity to grow towards a Lead Developer role
, taking increasing responsibility for technical direction, architecture and mentoring.

Your tasks:

► Designing and developing scalable, secure and high-performance web applications using .NET Core / C#, Angular and React

► Creating digital solutions that automate and improve HR, Purchasing and Engineering processes, including innovative use cases with agentic AI

► Making and contributing to architectural decisions across backend, frontend and data layers

► Designing and developing APIs, microservices and data solutions using PostgreSQL, MS SQL Server and MongoDB

► Supporting cloud-native deployment and operation using Docker, Kubernetes and Microsoft Azure

► Exploring and integrating AI-enhanced development tools and automation solutions
to improve productivity, software quality and development efficiency

► Mentoring developers, performing code reviews and contributing to development standards and best practices

► Collaborating closely with Product Owners, business stakeholders and technical teams to translate business requirements into effective digital solutions

► Taking ownership throughout the software lifecycle, including development, deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting and continuous improvement

Qualifications

► BSc or MSc degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Informatics or a related field, or equivalent professional experience

► 5+ years of professional software development experience
, preferably in fullstack development

► Strong hands-on experience with .NET Core and C#
, including backend services and API development

► Strong knowledge of Angular / TypeScript and/or React
and modern frontend development practices

► Strong experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL and MS SQL Server
, including database design, SQL and query optimization

► Good understanding of REST APIs, microservices, authentication and authorization
, as well as modern software architecture principles

Design and evolve scalable, maintainable services and web applications with clarity, simplicity, and long‑term sustainability in mind.

Technical Skills

Containers & Orchestration: experience with Docker (multi‑stage builds, hardened images) and Kubernetes deployments.
CI/CD & Developer Experience: automated build/test pipelines, code review hygiene, git branching, and quality gates.
Observability: structured logging, metrics, tracing (OpenTelemetry or similar), and building meaningful dashboards and alerts.

Strong analytical and problem‑solving abilities.

Ability to explain complex technical topics to both technical and non‑technical audiences.
Collaborative, proactive team player in international and multi‑disciplinary environments.

Experience with Nx monorepos and micro‑frontend architectures in large Angular ecosystems.

jobs.description:
Deine Aufgabe

Als Fullstack Engineer
bist du Teil eines Teams, das für die Prozessautomatisierung von Festnetzzugangsprojekten innerhalb der Telekom Deutschland verantwortlich ist. Du arbeitest in einem innovativen und agilen Umfeld und implementierst zukunftsorientierte Softwarelösungen zur Verwaltung und Planung des Hardware-Rollouts für das Festnetzzugangsnetz. Das Fixed Access Rollout Orchestration (FARO) System ist eine Cloud-native Softwareplattform, deren Hauptaufgabe die Automatisierung von Geschäftsprozessen ist, basierend auf einer Microservice-Architektur, die in C# .NET geschrieben ist. Das Team wird Konnektoren für FARO entwickeln und für die Entwicklung von Templates und APIs für Camunda verantwortlich sein.

Hauptaufgaben

Design, Entwicklung und Wartung skalierbarer Backend-Microservices mit C# .NET in einer Kubernetes-orchestrierten Umgebung
Implementierung und Verbesserung der Nachverfolgbarkeit, Beobachtbarkeit und Stabilität der wachsenden Microservice-Architektur durch Monitoring-Tools wie Grafana, Prometheus und Dapr
Entwicklung und Verbesserung von Frontend-Komponenten mit Angular zur Bereitstellung responsiver Benutzeroberflächen und Unterstützung schneller Feature-Deployments
Design und Implementierung von RESTful APIs und Integrationskonnektoren für FARO und die Camunda-Prozessautomatisierungsplattform
Modellierung, Konfiguration und Optimierung von Geschäftsprozessen unter Verwendung von BPMN-Standards im Camunda-Ökosystem
Containerisierung von Anwendungen mit Docker und Verwaltung von Deployment-Pipelines in Kubernetes-Clustern
Durchführung von Code-Reviews, Weitergabe von technischem Fachwissen und konstruktives Feedback während des gesamten Entwicklungszyklus zur Aufrechterhaltung der Code-Qualität und des Teamwachstums
Fehlerbehebung, Diagnose und Lösung von Performance-Engpässen und Systemproblemen in der Microservice-Architektur
Beitrag zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung von CI/CD-Pipelines und Deployment-Automatisierungsprozessen
Förderung von Innovation durch Evaluierung und Implementierung neuer Technologien und Best Practices in der Softwareentwicklung, einschließlich Design Patterns, Clean Code-Prinzipien und testgetriebener Entwicklung

Dein Profil

Wir suchen einen qualifizierten Fullstack Engineer
mit umfangreicher Erfahrung in der Backend-Entwicklung mit C# .NET, fundierten Kenntnissen in Microservice-Architekturen, Containerisierungstechnologien und Prozessautomatisierungsplattformen, kombiniert mit solidem Bildungshintergrund und kollaborativer Denkweise.

Muss-Kriterien

Abschluss in Informatik, Computer Science oder einem verwandten Bereich
Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung als Fullstack- oder Backend-Entwickler
Kenntnisse in mindestens einer objektorientierten Programmiersprache, vorzugsweise C#
Praktische Erfahrung mit Containerisierung mittels Docker
Praktische Erfahrung mit Orchestrierung mittels Kubernetes
Praktische Erfahrung mit Camunda
Kenntnisse in BPMN-Prozessmodellierung
Erfahrung in der Konfiguration und Entwicklung von Monitoring-Tools wie Grafana, Prometheus und Dapr
Vertraut mit gängigen Best Practices der Softwareentwicklung einschließlich Design Patterns
Vertraut mit Clean-Code-Prinzipien
Vertraut mit testgetriebener Entwicklung (TDD)
Vertraut mit Versionskontrollsystemen (Git)
Fundierte Kenntnisse in Microservice-Architekturen, vorzugsweise mit .NET und Kubernetes
Erfahrung im Design und der Implementierung von RESTful APIs
Erfahrung im Design und der Implementierung von Integration Connectors
Analytische und lösungsorientierte Herangehensweise an Problemstellungen
Angetrieben von der Bereitschaft zu wachsen und dich und dein Team kontinuierlich dazu zu bringen, innovative Ideen zu erkunden
Fähigkeit, in einem agilen Arbeitsumfeld erfolgreich zu sein
Begeisterung für kollaborative Entwicklungspraktiken
Interesse an Telekommunikationstechnologien und deren Anwendungen
Gute Englischkenntnisse

Von Vorteil

Deutschkenntnisse
Erfahrung mit Angular und die Fähigkeit, schnelle und effektive Anpassungen am Frontend vorzunehmen
Praktische Erfahrung mit CI/CD-Pipelines und Deployment-Automatisierungsprozessen
Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in Performance-Optimierung und Troubleshooting komplexer Systemprobleme
Vertrautheit mit aufkommenden Technologien und Best Practices in der Softwareentwicklung
Begeisterung dafür, aufkommende Technologien und Best Practices zu evaluieren und zu implementieren

Über uns

Als attraktivster Arbeitgeber Ungarns im Jahr 2025 (laut repräsentativer Umfrage von Randstad) ist Deutsche Telekom IT Solutions
eine Tochtergesellschaft der Deutsche Telekom Gruppe. Das Unternehmen bietet mit mehr als 5300 Mitarbeitern ein breites Portfolio an IT- und Telekommunikationsdienstleistungen. Wir haben Hunderte von Großkunden und Konzernen in Deutschland und anderen europäischen Ländern.

DT-ITS erhielt 2019 den Best in Educational Cooperation Award von HIPA
und wurde als ethischstes multinationales Unternehmen 2019
anerkannt. Das Unternehmen entwickelt kontinuierlich seine vier Standorte in Budapest, Debrecen, Pécs und Szeged weiter und sucht qualifizierte IT-Fachkräfte, die Teil des Teams werden möchten.

Improve solution design, documentation and realisation of custom merchant solutions

Translate product, business and technical requirements into solutions
Being constantly up to date with industry standards in order to offer the best bespoke solutions to our merchantsConduct thorough upfront qualification of merchant needs and technical infrastructure.

new_jobs.title: Afstudeerstage Stryker.NET hot reload mutating and testing
new_jobs.description:
Hot reload kan mogelijk de performance verbeteren door enkel noodzakelijke delen van de code opnieuw te compileren en irrelevante unit tests te verwijderen. Het doel is te onderzoeken of deze techniek het plaatsen van mutanten en het uitvoeren van relevante tests ten goede komt. Vervolgens bewijs je de resultaten met een Proof of Concept en draag je jouw bevindingen en implementatie aan bij de open source Stryker community.

Stryker is het mutation test framework voor .NET, JS/TS en de JVM. Bugs, of mutanten, worden automatisch gegenereerd in jouw source code. Vervolgens worden per mutatie alle unit tests uitgevoerd. Wanneer minimaal één test faalt, markeren we de mutatie als killed. Als de tests slagen, markeren we de mutatie als survived. Hoe meer killed mutaties, hoe effectiever jouw unit tests. Dit geeft een beter beeld dan code coverage omdat daadwerkelijk bewezen wordt dat de tests effectief zijn.

De huidige workflow in Stryker is als volgt:

De gebruiker installeert Stryker en roept deze aan via command line
Stryker plaatst mutaties in de sourcecode door ze in conditional statements te zetten
Door het switchen van een globale variabele kunnen deze mutaties geactiveerd worden
Stryker zoekt uit welke mutaties tegelijk gedraaid kunnen worden, oftewel welke mutaties geen conflicterende code paden hebben
Stryker start per mutatie batch een test sessie op en zet bepaalde mutaties aan
Stryker bekijkt de test resultaten om te bepalen of een mutatie killed of survived is.

Het veelvuldig compileren en testen van mutaties kost veel tijd. Om dit te beperken plaatst Stryker de mutaties met behulp van conditional statements in de sourcecode. Hierdoor is meestal maar één compilatie nodig, ongeacht het aantal mutaties. Het plaatsen van mutaties in conditional statements kan echter complex en foutgevoelig zijn.

Een alternatieve en in theorie veiligere methode is het plaatsen van mutaties één voor één. Het nadeel aan deze methode is dat elke aanpassing aan de broncode een nieuwe compilatie vereist.

Tijdens een recent overleg met Microsoft-ontwikkelaars kwam het onderwerp ‘hot reload’ voorbij. Door middel van hot reload kan de C#-compiler ontdekken welke codepaden zijn aangepast en zal de compiler alleen de noodzakelijke delen hercompileren. Deze techniek is ook toepasbaar op unit tests waardoor we potentieel alle niet relevante unit tests uit de broncode kunnen verwijderen. We weten echter nog niet hoe we hot reload programmatisch aan kunnen roepen en in hoeverre dit de bestaande conditional statements techniek kan ondersteunen of vervangen.

De opdracht

Onderzoek:

Onderzoek of hot reload het plaatsen van mutanten, het uitvoeren van de relevante unit tests en de performance van Stryker ten goede komt.

Implementatie:

Bewijs met behulp van een Proof of Concept de conclusies uit het onderzoek. Maak een plan voor de implementatie van hot reload in Stryker en draag dit bij aan de open source Stryker community.

Relevante documentatie:

https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/visualstudio/debugger/edit-and-continue-visual-csharp

https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/visualstudio/test/test-execution-with-hot-reload

new_jobs.title: Afstudeerstage Seamless deployment of a data platform
new_jobs.description:
Dataplatforms veranderen continu, maar hoe voorkom je dat deze wijzigingen zorgen voor downtime of verstoorde rapportages? In deze afstudeeropdracht onderzoek je hoe je aanpassingen aan datastructuren en -modellen slim kunt doorvoeren zónder de beschikbaarheid van data te onderbreken. Je ontwikkelt en test een strategie waarmee je laat zien dat stabiele, toekomstbestendige deployments ook in dynamische Azure-omgevingen mogelijk zijn.

In een wereld waarin data essentieel is voor besluitvorming is de betrouwbaarheid en continuïteit van een dataplatform van cruciaal belang. Zeker in organisaties die actief dataplatforms beheren en optimaliseren in de Azure Cloud, zijn wijzigingen aan datastructuren en -modellen onvermijdelijk. Ze sluiten aan op nieuwe inzichten en veranderende bedrijfsbehoeften.

Een nadeel is dat veel dataplatforms bij zulke wijzigingen minder beschikbaar zijn, bijvoorbeeld door onderhoud of deployments waarbij onderdelen opnieuw geladen moeten worden. Dit leidt tot onderbrekingen in rapportages en analyses. Hoe kun je dergelijke wijzigingen doorvoeren zonder downtime of verlies van beschikbaarheid? En welke ontwerpkeuzes maken dat mogelijk? Dit is een herkenbare uitdaging voor veel organisaties die werken met grote hoeveelheden data en continue beschikbaarheid vereisen.

De opdracht

Onderzoek hoe wijzigingen aan datastructuren en -modellen binnen SQL Server(less) databases en Analysis Services-omgevingen in Azure Cloud zó uitgerold kunnen worden dat de beschikbaarheid van data behouden blijft. Ontwerp en evalueer hiervoor een strategie of patroon, bijvoorbeeld via een Blue-Green deployment, feature toggles of gescheiden laagringen. Werk dit uit in een Proof of Concept (PoC) binnen Azure DevOps waarmee je laat zien dat downtimevrije deployments haalbaar zijn.
